title: System Maintenance & Backup
summary: Maintenance tools, DayPass engine config backups, logs and package updates.

items.title: Maintenance & Recovery
items.description: Purge DayPass packages, clean caches, sysupgrade backup or factory reset.
items.usage_tip: Its own manual opens with h inside the menu.

items.title: Backup DayPass Engine Configs
items.description: Archives /etc/config/passwall, passwall2, xray, sing-box and niki into /tmp/daypass/backups (latest_backup.tar.gz points to the newest).
items.usage_tip: Backups live in /tmp and are lost on reboot; copy them off the router.

items.title: Restore DayPass Engine Configs
items.description: Lists the backups, then extracts the chosen archive (default latest) over / after confirmation.

items.title: Log Viewer
items.description: Shows the last lines of logread filtered for DayPass and engines, network (netifd, dnsmasq, mwan3), kernel (USB / modem events) or everything.
items.usage_tip: Kernel logs show whether a phone or modem was recognised.

items.title: System Updates
items.description: Checks and updates the packages DayPass installed.

items.title: Back to Main Menu
items.usage_tip: Nothing is changed by leaving this menu.

items.title: Quit DayPass
items.description: Ends the DayPass session from any menu.
items.usage_tip: Ctrl+C does the same and restores the terminal.

items.title: Help
items.description: Opens the manual of the current screen.
items.usage_tip: Enter or 0 inside a manual returns to the screen you came from; q quits DayPass.
